name: cc-orchestrador-subagents
description: Multi-agent development orchestrator for Claude Code. Coordinates OpenSpec, orchestrator-led planning, Codex review/back-end and Antigravity/AGY front-end subagents in parallel (including native Gemini subagent fan-out via --agy-parallel/--agy-subagent-model), supports autonomous /goal execution, then produces consolidated subagent context, an implementation report and business-level user instructions.
